metadata.description: Wire format for the final `vibe <phase> --json` lifecycle report. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/lifecycle_report/`.
The exact default-lifecycle phase requested by the user.
The executed phase spellings in order, including a leading `clean` when the clean lifecycle was composed.
One outcome for every phase in `chain`, in the same order.
Phase outcome vocabulary. R2.2 writes `ok`, `fresh`, or `no-op`; later engine slices may add already normative outcomes without breaking older readers.
